acquisition_order_caveat: Conditions repeat in fixed ascending order within every cycle. Sweep value is perfectly confounded with within-cycle position, although each condition recurs across ten cycles.

bright_wait.occupancy_dependence_gate: Selection requires the validation-shot corrected-count versus site-free-background coupling reported above to remain below the predeclared method gate. Frozen train-only apparent-occupancy coupling is evaluated downstream as a separate sensitivity.

selection.criterion: minimum validation-shot site-free residual block-median structure; corrected-count/background coupling is a physical-validity gate and tie-break

dark_hold.occupancy_dependence_gate: Selection requires the validation-shot corrected-count versus site-free-background coupling reported above to remain below the predeclared method gate. Frozen train-only apparent-occupancy coupling is evaluated downstream as a separate sensitivity.

selection.criterion: minimum validation-shot site-free residual block-median structure; corrected-count/background coupling is a physical-validity gate and tie-break

background_evidence.selection_rule: validation-shot site-free residual spatial structure with background coupling as a gate/tie-break; model separation and test shots are excluded

alternate_whole_cycle_split.primary_background_template_note: The count table retains the primary chronological-training geometry/template; this sensitivity changes statistical split assignment, while all-data geometry is assessed separately.

cycle_drift_sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity only: a cycle trend can indicate loading or run drift left after the bright-wait model.

effective_model.interpretation: Effective apparent decay during the commanded illuminated wait; not an intrinsic bright-state lifetime.

post_wait_control.interpretation: A resolved trend indicates wait-dependent survivor state or classification change; it is not a direct heating measurement.

site_free_background_curve.scope: Selected training-shot template plus per-frame site-free offset, averaged across sites within each complete shot.

timing_evidence.scope: commanded EXPOSURES timing and compiled switch/DDS commands; not measured light power or per-frame hardware timestamps
